reserveReview.rationale: Refreshed 2026-09-29 after the prior composition (as of 2026-06-30) crossed the v9 freshness bound. Theo's disclosures identify thBILL as a diversified basket of Wellington/Libeara ULTRA and Fidelity International FILQ, and a pinned Ethereum mainnet read at block 26083836 (2026-09-29T14:50:35Z) confirms the ULTRA leg live on-chain today: the thBILL token contract 0x5FA487BCa6158c64046B2813623e20755091DA0b holds 35,645,094.648 tULTRA (token 0x82b840b6edf77f90c92a70b99f0b5d50e7967330), equal to that token's entire totalSupply. A full-list ERC-20 balance scan of the thBILL token contract, the thBILL minter (0x8a2c307D1462Ff4fA98c9c119D3A3457AD505Eb1), and the thBILL Backing Wallet (0xAECCa546baFB16735b273702632C8Cbb83509d8F) at blocks 26083833-26083836 found no FILQ token, consistent with the FILQ allocation being held through Sygnum's institutional rails rather than Theo's Ethereum contracts, as the June 30, 2026 announcement describes. Observed thBILL supply at the same blocks spans Ethereum 36,252,237.55, Arbitrum 348,419.09, Base 215.96, HyperEVM 1,297,264.23, and Stable 31.93. Current allocation weights between ULTRA and FILQ remain undisclosed, so the full basket is treated as an opaque fund-share exposure rather than all Treasury bills; FILQ's mandate includes asset-backed commercial paper, which carries credit exposure beyond Treasury-only funds. Redemption is documented at T+1 with underlying collateral settled within T+4 business days, bounding the liquidity horizon at seven days.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pinned Ethereum mainnet RPC reads at blocks 26083833-26083836 (2026-09-29T14:50:35Z) of the thBILL token contract, minter, and backing wallet, cross-referenced with Theo documentation re-verified onchain September 1, 2026 and the issuer's current product and fact-sheet pages
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The basket structure is identified and confirmed current by direct on-chain observation of the ULTRA leg and issuer documentation of the FILQ leg; the unknown is limited to the allocation split between Wellington ULTRA and Fidelity International FILQ, which is expressed by the opaque fund-share slice rather than by an unresolved composition.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: ULTRA is custodied by Standard Chartered Bank per the Wellington ULTRA fact sheet; FILQ's custodian and fund administrator is J.P. Morgan per the FILQ fact sheet, with tokenization by Sygnum (Desygnate). Provider share percentages between ULTRA and FILQ, segregation, rehypothecation, and thBILL holders' direct legal claim against the underlying fund assets are not published in the reviewed sources.
